page_title: BAR 3-1 ELC | Barcelona v Elche 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Miguel Sesma has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The linesman raises his flag. Hector Fort (Elche) is adjudged offside.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ferran Torres departs the field of play to be replaced by Dro Fernandez (Barcelona).
88' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Lamine Yamal will be replaced by Roony Bardghji (Barcelona).
88' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of John Donald (Elche) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning.
86' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
82' A substitution has been made. Adria Pedrosa is replaced by John Donald (Elche).
81' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Yago Santiago (Elche) heads on.
78' Rafa Mir (Elche) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley well wide of the right post from inside the box.
78' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
77' The game is interrupted as Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is flagged offside.
77' Rafa Mir (Elche) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but Wojciech Szczesny was alert and made an amazing save!
74' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Andre Silva walks off the pitch to be replaced by Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche).
74' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gerard Martin (Barcelona) replacing Alejandro Balde.
74' Substitution. Marcus Rashford makes his way off the pitch and Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) comes on as his replacement.
73' Hector Fort (Elche) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
73' Elche work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
73' Hector Fort (Elche) strikes a volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his effort. The ball is out of play. Elche win a corner kick.
70' Eder Sarabia has decided to substitute German Valera and he is replaced by Yago Santiago (Elche).
70' Pedro Bigas doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Hector Fort (Elche) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
68' Rafa Mir (Elche) wasted a clear opportunity. He fired a first-time shot from point-blank range, but it rattled the right post.
67' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
66' Substitution. Fermin Lopez is replaced by Dani Olmo (Barcelona).

61' 3 - 1 A good lofted pass from Fermin Lopez finds Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) on the edge of the area. He collects the ball and rips in a wonderful shot which bounces off the bar and ends up in the back of the net. The score is now 3:1.
60' The attendance for today's match is 44370.
55' OFF THE WOODWORK! Rafa Mir (Elche) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar!
54' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
52' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) has a goal ruled out for offside!
51' Handball by Rafa Mir (Elche).
50' The resulting corner, taken by German Valera (Elche), comes to nothing.
46' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
46' It is time for a substitution. Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) is on for Martim Neto.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
45+2' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
45+2' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

45+2' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Ferran Torres (Barcelona) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Inaki Pena pulls off a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
42' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Alvaro Nunez laid the ball off to Rafa Mir (Elche), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
40' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

39' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Inaki Pena thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
39' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
39' Marc Casado (Barcelona) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
38' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Barcelona.
38' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
35' Martim Neto (Elche) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Miguel Sesma didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
35' That was close. Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
33' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
32' Elche couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Wojciech Szczesny (Barcelona) leaped high and intercepted the cross.

32' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Miguel Sesma blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Free kick. Elche will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
25' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Fermin Lopez (Barcelona), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
24' The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
24' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
23' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) takes the corner with a short pass.
21' Alvaro Nunez (Elche) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
21' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
16' Barcelona fail to score from a corner as Inaki Pena (Elche) leaps to collect the ball.
11' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Fermin Lopez is the provider as he slips the ball to Ferran Torres (Barcelona) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 2:0.
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Alejandro Balde shows great vision to find Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
8' Alvaro Nunez (Elche) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
5' Rafa Mir (Elche) is adjudged offside.
3' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) is caught offside!
2' German Valera (Elche) works the corner short.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Barcelona will take the kick-off.
Miguel Sesma will officiate today.
